problem: The paragraph says the OS manages four broad resources, but then defines five abstractions (process, thread, address space, file, pipe) without ever naming the four resources. A student cannot tell what the four resources are until the table.
fix: Name them first: 'The OS manages four broad resources: the CPU, main memory, storage, and I/O devices. Each becomes an abstraction a program sees.' Then define process, thread, address space, file and pipe.

problem: The text says 'The figure after Section 1 shows this path', but the figure is placed after Section 3. The reader looks in the wrong place.
fix: Say 'The figure at the end of this section shows this path.'

problem: Section 3 lists the layers as applications, libraries, system call interface, kernel, hardware, but the figure drops the libraries layer, so the figure and the text do not match.
fix: Add a 'Libraries' block between Applications and the System call interface, or remove libraries from the layer list in the text.

problem: 'The kernel is the core privileged part that always runs' can be read as 'kernel code executes at all times', which is false: kernel code runs only on system calls, interrupts and faults.
fix: Write: 'The kernel is the core privileged part; it is always resident in memory and runs whenever an app needs a service or a device raises an interrupt.'
